title: Design System: Solar RP website
scope: The landing page (index.html, src/styles.css over src/base.css). The log-in, sign-up and account pages still use base.css and its older plates and warm tokens; they have not been redesigned into this system.

display.purpose: The hero H1 only; 38px on phones.

subtitle.purpose: Step titles (21px), quest title (19px), FAQ questions (18px).

server-name.purpose: The server's own name in the live card; the only capitals on the page.

figure.purpose: Live player count (22px) and the coin reward (26px, gold); tabular figures.

lede.purpose: Hero lede, feature text, download lede at 44-46ch.

body.purpose: Base text; tabular figures by default.

nav.purpose: Bar and footer links, sentence case.

button.purpose: Button labels, sentence case; 15/16/17/18px for sm/default/lg/xl.

label.purpose: dt labels, the SHA-256 caption, the updated age (12-13px, ink-3).

cuts.name: cut-shape
cuts.purpose: The S mark's corner: top-right and bottom-left at 45 degrees.

shadows.name: hero-title
shadows.purpose: Display text over the photo only; removed on phones.

shadows.name: hero-lede
shadows.purpose: Body text over the photo only; removed on phones.

shadows.name: nav-over-photo
shadows.purpose: Bar links while the bar is transparent.

motion.name: rise
motion.value: 900ms, translateY(16px) and opacity to rest, once on load; server card +120ms
motion.purpose: Hero copy and the SOL card.

motion.name: push
motion.purpose: The hero photo; off at 560px and below and under reduced motion.

motion.name: reveal
motion.value: 800ms, translateY(24px) and opacity, once on entering the viewport

motion.name: capacity
motion.purpose: The capacity fill easing to a new reading.

narrative.overview:
The site is the launcher seen from outside: a calm, technical product page on neutral charcoal, in the register of fivem.net and alt:V rather than a trailer or a fan poster. One in-game photo world, a bright sunset still of Vespucci Beach, opens the page full-bleed and closes it under the download panel; everything between is charcoal panels, hairlines and sentence-case Sofia Sans. The hero's right column holds SOL as the launcher shows it, live, so the first thing a visitor learns is that the server is up and how many people are on it.

Density is moderate and quiet. Copy is short, in sentence case, and sits on panels or directly on the ground; the gold of the S mark is rationed to what a visitor can act on and to the few figures that matter (capacity, the coin reward). Shapes come from the mark itself: every button, panel and picture is cut at 45 degrees on the top-right and bottom-left corners, the way the S is, and nothing is rounded.

This world replaces three rejected ones (the trailer page, the quiet community hub, and the warm "Big RP project" home): the warm sunset/ember/cream section grounds, floating tilted photos, photo marquees, ticking hero numbers and condensed all-caps slogans of those rounds are confirmed rejections.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral charcoal ground with three panel steps; no warm tint anywhere in the chrome.
One accent, the mark's gold, on actions, the capacity fill, the 2 px top rule of the two key panels and the coin reward.
Sofia Sans only: 800 with negative tracking for headings, 400 for sentences, sentence case everywhere.
The S-mark cut (top-right and bottom-left, 45 degrees) on every rectangle; no border-radius.
A live server card is the signature: real status, real player count, an age that ticks.
Motion is a single rise on load, one slow push-in of the hero photo on desktop, and rows that fade in once.

rules.name: The Rationed Gold Rule
rules.body: Gold marks only what you can press, the capacity fill, the top rule of the SOL card and the download panel, the coin reward, and the brand marks. Section grounds, headings, labels and decorative lines are never gold.

rules.name: The Launcher Parity Rule
rules.body: Status colours are the launcher's: green up, amber maintenance, coral down. Do not invent a fourth or recolour them for the site.

rules.name: The Neutral Ground Rule
rules.body: The chrome is neutral charcoal. Warmth comes from the photograph and the gold, never from a tinted section band.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Headings, nav, buttons and labels are sentence case at letter-spacing 0 or tighter. No condensed faces and no all-caps text on this page; server names are the only capitals, because they are names.

rules.name: The Tight Heading Rule
rules.body: Every heading is 700-800 with negative tracking (-0.01 to -0.03em) and `text-wrap: balance`; body text gets `text-wrap: pretty`.

rules.name: The Photo-Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: A shadow exists only to keep text readable over the photograph. Nothing on charcoal casts one.

rules.name: The Mark's Cut Rule
rules.body: Every button, panel and picture frame is cut top-right and bottom-left at 45 degrees, depth 8-22 px by size; never rounded, never cut on one corner only.

dos: **Do** keep gold to buttons, the capacity fill, the 2 px top rule of the SOL card and the download panel, the coin reward and the brand marks.
**Do** cut every button, panel and picture at the top-right and bottom-left at 45 degrees (buttons 8-14 px, panels and pictures 16-22 px).
**Do** draw a line that must follow the cut as an evenodd polygon ring on a pseudo-element, not a border or inset shadow.
**Do** set headings in Sofia Sans 800 with negative tracking, sentence case; sentences in 400.
**Do** show real data in the server card: the true player count, the bar only when someone is on, the age of the reading.
**Do** separate rows inside a panel with 1 px hairlines at white 14 %, and step depth with panel, panel-2 and panel-3.
**Do** use the launcher's status colours (green up, amber maintenance, coral down) for server state.
**Do** keep motion to transform and opacity, and switch it all off under reduced motion.
donts: **Don't** use border-radius on rectangles, or cut only one corner.
**Don't** use condensed faces or all-caps text for headings, nav or buttons.
**Don't** tint section grounds with warm gradient bands (sunset, ember, cream); the chrome stays charcoal.
**Don't** float or tilt photos, run photo marquees, or tick numbers up in the hero.
**Don't** put box shadows on panels or buttons; shadows exist only for text over the photograph.
**Don't** use gold for headings, labels, section backgrounds or decorative lines.
**Don't** show a capacity bar or a player figure the server did not report.
